facilities.name: Guonjarjohka / Kuonjarjoki open wilderness hut and shared rental hut
facilities.description: Combined hut site on the Nordkalott Trail in Käsivarsi Wilderness Reserve. Eräluvat lists a 10-bed shared rental hut; facility record also includes an open wilderness hut side. Stove, firewood for heating, gas stove, dry toilet nearby; no electricity or running water.
facilities.routeProximity: about 8-24 m from OSM/E1/Luontoon route line

facilities.routeProximity: about 26-38 m from measured route line

facilities.description: Footbridge at the old Saarijärvi route/bridge cluster, near the route-line endpoint used by OSM/E1.
facilities.routeProximity: on or immediately adjacent to OSM/Luontoon route line

facilities.name: Saarijärvi new dry toilet

facilities.name: Saarijärvi new open wilderness hut / autiotupa
facilities.description: Current free open wilderness hut at Saarijärvi, opened in 2023. Natural water nearby must be treated; dry toilet and other hut-yard services nearby.
facilities.routeProximity: about 151-154 m from OSM/Luontoon route-line endpoint near old Saarijärvi cluster

facilities.name: Saarijärvi recycling / waste storage
facilities.description: Official waste/recycling point appears in Luontoon/Retkikartta data, but hut rules also emphasize packing waste out.

facilities.name: Saarijärvi shared rental hut / Kiiruna and Naali
facilities.description: Reservable hut building with Kiiruna and Naali subunits, each 8 beds. Pets prohibited in reservable hut side.
facilities.routeProximity: current hut yard is offset from old route-line endpoint; exact access spur pending
